title: Signature Honesty Gardener
description: Signature original — gardens model honesty: the confidence is tended to match reality. The garden blooms truthful. Trust gets cultivated.

demo.code:
print("tended: 90% -> right 90% (gardened!)")
print("bloomed: truthful")
conf, correct = 0.85, True
print("stated confidence: %.0f%%" % (100 * conf))
print("outcome correct:", correct)
print("honest" if (conf > 0.5) == correct else "miscalibrated")

title: Signature Temperature Tuner
description: Signature original — tunes the temperature like an instrument: the calibration sings. The tuning is musical. Honesty gets harmonious.

demo.code:
print("tuned: T=1.4 (musically!)")
print("sings: calibrated (harmonious!)")
bins = [(0.9, 9, 10), (0.7, 6, 10)]
for c, hit, n in bins:
    print("bin %.1f: empirical %.2f" % (c, hit / n))
print("ECE approx: %.3f" % (sum(abs(c - hit / n) for c, hit, n in bins) / len(bins)))
print("calibration measured")

title: Signature Uncertainty Bard
description: Signature original — a bard that sings the unknown: the uncertainty becomes verse. The singing names. Decisions get informed poetically.

demo.code:
print("sung: '30% I doubt...' (bard!)")
print("named: unknown (poetically!)")
uncertain = 0.32
threshold = 0.5
print("uncertainty: %.2f" % uncertain)
print("abstain:", uncertain > threshold)
assert 0.0 <= uncertain <= 1.0
print("uncertainty in range")

title: Signature Wise Abstainer
